title: Moses Shines
textBlocks:
Hello Bravehearts
In today’s lesson we are going back to Moses
Moses climbs the mountain again!

When Moses came back down the mountain, 
his face was shining!

WE MUST SHINE TOO
but we must not cover it up

ACTIVITY
Can you help Moses climb up the mountain?

PRAYER TIME
Dear Lord Jesus
Thank you for coming into this dark world and shining light.
Please help me to shine for You.
Please let me say kind words to my friends.
Please help me to do kind things for people.
In Jesus Name
Amen.
